why: The authors released the R scripts and an renv.lock for the illustrative example. Claims C1/C2 require only a 4x4 generalized eigenproblem from a self-contained simulated example; no external data or weights are needed. The only likely setup is installing R and restoring the declared CRAN packages.
blockers_seen: The machine has Python but no R runtime listed; this is an R-only repository requiring R 4.3.3 and CRAN packages declared in renv.lock.
First run may require renv::restore(); package installation is the main setup cost, not the computation.

feasibility.est_runtime_on_this_machine: Seconds for the 4x4 eigenproblem once R and packages are installed; first-time R/package setup may take several minutes.

compute.basis: C1/C2 are a tiny self-contained simulated example solved by one 4x4 generalized eigenproblem; the dominant cost is one-time R/renv package installation, not numerical work.
